about: A primate face: no muzzle pad, a short or flat muzzle under a brow ridge (gorilla, chimpanzee, baboon in part).
rules: The nose is a broad, flat pad of bare skin with flared nostrils outlined by a raised rim; the upper lip is long and mobile, the lips thick and bare.
The face is bare, dark skin from the brow to the chin: paint it as lit, wrinkled skin (creases under the eyes and across the nose), not fur.
The brow ridge is geometry, overhanging the eyes, which sit deep in shadowed sockets; the jaw is deep and juts forward.
